label: TP
reason: At least one alert is confirmed as TP. The SQL injection alert (java/sql-injection) shows user-provided data reaching a database query sink without any mitigation on the path. The XSS alert (java/xss) also shows user-provided data reaching an HTML sink, although the code includes encodeForHTML, which is applied to the SQL query string rather than the tainted data itself, making it ineffective for XSS protection.

evidence.note: SQL injection sink where user-provided value 'bar' is concatenated into SQL query without any sanitization or parameterization.
XSS sink where user-provided value is used in HTML output, though encodeForHTML is applied to the SQL string instead of the actual tainted data.
